clips.title: The story
paras: Umpi is a frog residing in Tarren Mill as the unwitting laboratory assistant of Apothecary Lydon. Kept inside the Royal Apothecary Society's workshop, she serves as a recurring test subject for experimental toxins and plague concoctions.

Within the dark laboratories of Tarren Mill, the Forsaken work tirelessly to brew concoctions of death and torment. For Apothecary Lydon, scientific rigor requires living flesh to test his formulas, and Umpi bears the brunt of these trials. Lydon regularly tests lethal brews—such as the Elixir of Suffering and the Elixir of Agony—directly on her. Once the poisons take their inevitable toll and kill her, the apothecary re-animates the amphibian, ensuring she is ready to endure the next lethal dose for the glory of the Royal Apothecary Society.
